examples.text: Да как же я тебе их отвлеку?
examples.trans: Just how am I supposed to distract them for you?

examples.trans: German, I beg you, do not make a bet with him!

examples.text: Надо показать ему, что мы умеем готовить!
examples.trans: We must show him that we know how to cook!

examples.trans: Our restaurant is truly very rich in bright talents!

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (root 'мочь'). Used in Russian as an perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to help', forming an aspectual pair with 'помогать'.

examples.text: Так может быть, тебе надо чем-то помочь?
